title: Automating Your Workflow with n8n
content:
# Automating Your Workflow with n8n

n8n is an open-source workflow automation tool that connects services and automates tasks.

## Key Concepts
- Nodes: Individual actions or triggers
- Workflows: Connected sequences of nodes
- Triggers: Events that start workflows

## Example Workflows
1. GitHub → Portfolio Sync
2. LinkedIn Post Generator
3. PDF OCR Pipeline
4. Lead Generation

## Why n8n?
- Self-hosted for privacy
- 300+ integrations
- Visual editor
- Code nodes when you need custom logic
- Free and open-source
excerpt: How to build powerful automation workflows without writing code.
